details: Amnesty table lists 970; Yle 500 is pre-event expectation; observer’s first-person account reports several dozen near one intersection around 17:00. Need exact scope, count method, simultaneity, and whether Finland-directed demands were made at Helsinki event.

Queries were Finnish/English and heavily weighted to Yle and Helsinki; regional independent/local outlets, other sectors, additional local demonstrations, and protest records outside indexed open web remain unsearched. This is not an exhaustive survey or a zero-event claim.
